description: Create a discount; it comes out of the operator's payout, never out of the platform commission. Returns the stored discount.

auto_apply.description: true applies it without a code.

code.description: The code guests type; required unless trigger is pay_in_full.

company_id.description: Company id, from list_boats (`company_id`) or get_company.

currency.description: EUR or USD: the currency a fixed amount is in.

discount_value.description: The percent, or for fixed the amount in `currency` (EUR when omitted).

end_date.description: Last day it can be booked, YYYY-MM-DD.

start_date.description: First day it can be booked, YYYY-MM-DD.

trigger.description: `code` (default) or `pay_in_full`, a percentage taken when the guest pays everything at once.

name: create_discount
